title: Maine Government Feeds Catalog
description: Catalog of all monitored Maine government, court, and legal-agency sources.

items.title: Supreme Judicial Court (Law Court) Published Opinions
items.content_text: Maine Judicial Branch / Supreme Judicial Court Opinions
items._notes: Table of opinions: Opinion # / Case (linked PDF) / Date, newest year first.

items.title: Business and Consumer Docket (BCD) Orders and Decisions
items.content_text: Maine Judicial Branch / Business and Consumer Docket opinions/orders
items._notes: Two sections (Appeals, Civil Actions), each an HTML table: Docket # / Case / Order-Decision (linked PDF) / Date. Title uses the Case column (party names) rather than the order column, whose text is just "Order"/"Decision and Order" and made every feed item title identical.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Proposed Rule Amendments
items._notes: Prose page (no repeating list structure) describing active proposed rule changes and comment deadlines; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Administrative Orders
items._notes: Single table of Order Number / Name (linked PDF) / Subject / Issued-Amended Date covering all SJC/AOC administrative orders, including standing orders (see jb-standing-orders, same source table).

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Standing Orders
items._notes: No dedicated standing-orders page exists; standing orders are rows within the same Administrative Orders table. Uses the same source/selectors as jb-admin-orders but filtered to titles containing 'Standing Order', so this feed carries only standing orders.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Court Forms (mjbportal database)
items._notes: The searchable forms database (which the old static forms page fronts) server-renders a table of ~350 forms: Form Number / Form Name (linked download) / Revision Date. Revision-date changes surface as new items. Header row has no links and is skipped by the parser. Supersedes full-page-fingerprint monitoring of the static forms index.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Court Fees Schedule
items._notes: Official schedule of filing/entry fees and fee-related administrative order links; prose+link page with no repeating dated list, monitored by full-page fingerprint so fee changes surface as page-change items.

items.title: Maine eCourts / eFileMaine News & Announcements
items._notes: Unordered list of date-prefixed announcement links specific to eCourts/eFiling rollout. Titles carry an M/D/YYYY prefix, parsed as the publication date via date_from_title.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch News & Announcements
items.content_text: Maine Judicial Branch / Judicial Branch news
items._notes: General Judicial Branch newsroom — a date-prefixed list of announcement links (new courthouses, eCourts rollout, bar-exam and administrative news), broader than the eFiling-specific jb-efiling-notices and the closure-focused jb-court-alerts. Same 'ul.newslist li' structure as jb-efiling-notices. Titles carry an M/D/YYYY prefix, parsed as the publication date via date_from_title — the archive lists far more than 50 items, and without real dates the feed window churned.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Court Alerts & Closings
items.content_text: Maine Judicial Branch / Jury/court closure notices
items._notes: Definition-list (dt/dd) of court closures and alerts with no per-item links; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Judicial Branch Jury Status Notices
items.content_text: Maine Judicial Branch / Jury/court closure notices
items._notes: Table of per-county jury reporting status notices with no reliable per-row link; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Legislature Bill Directory (current Legislature)
items._notes: Two-row-per-bill HTML table; monitored by full-page fingerprint rather than per-bill selectors because the row pairing isn't reducible to one CSS selector. Deliberately omits the 'snum' session-number query parameter: the Legislature's own site defaults this page to the current Legislature automatically (verified: fetching this URL with no snum returns the 132nd Legislature's bills as of mid-2026), so no manual update is needed when the 133rd Legislature convenes.

items.title: Maine Legislature Schedule of Public Hearings and Work Sessions
items._notes: Index page links to client-rendered (AJAX) hearing schedules; monitored by full-page fingerprint as a safety net. Structured per-hearing extraction lives in leg-hearings-schedule, which POSTs to the underlying JSON endpoint (a plain GET to it returns only a stale dump of 1990s sessions).

items.title: Maine Legislature Public Hearings & Work Sessions (structured schedule)
items._notes: Structured hearing/work-session data POSTed from the Legislature's own schedule endpoint (legislature.maine.gov/bills/getPHWSForDate.asp, the same call the phwkSched.html page makes client-side), covering a window from 7 days back to 38 days ahead. Each item is one scheduled Public Hearing or Work Session with bill, committee, time, and room; the ICS calendar for this source carries real event times and locations. Zero items outside legislative sessions is normal, not a failure.

items.title: Maine Law and Legislative Reference Library — New/Popular Items
items.content_text: Maine Legislature / Law and Legislative Reference Library news
items._subcategory: Law and Legislative Reference Library news
items._notes:
'NEW or POPULAR ITEMS' section is a heading followed by sibling

entries, not a single selectable list container; monitored by full-page fingerprint. NOTE: the site declares (but does not functionally serve) an Atom feed at /rss.php which currently returns HTTP 500 — worth re-checking periodically in case it is restored.

items.title: Maine Legislature — Laws of Maine (Session/Chaptered Law)
items.content_text: Maine Legislature / Chaptered laws / public laws
items._notes: This is a Durandal/Breeze single-page app; the static HTML shell does not change when content updates, so page-fingerprint monitoring will likely under-report changes. API RECON (2026-08): the SPA talks to a Breeze service at /ros/LawsOfMaine/breeze/Law/ — getLegislatures returns live JSON, but getLawGroup returned empty for every legislature/session/type/chapter combination tried (GET and POST). If a future attempt maps working getLawGroup parameters, this source can be converted to structured per-law items like leg-hearings-schedule.

items.title: Maine Revised Statutes — List of Titles
items._notes: Static page whose single 'current through <date>' disclaimer sentence is the practical change signal; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Secretary of State — Bureau of Corporations, Elections & Commissions News
items.content_text: Maine Secretary of State / Bureau of Corporations
items._notes: Sitewide SOS news feed (not corporations-specific, but corporations/elections/commissions announcements are posted here; the Bureau has no dedicated feed of its own).

items.title: Maine UCC (Uniform Commercial Code) Filing Division
items._notes: Static informational/services page with no dated listing; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Secretary of State — Elections Division News
items._notes: Elections hub page is static; election-specific announcements (recounts, RCV tabulations) are posted to the sitewide SOS news feed, filtered here by election-related title keywords. Keyword filtering is heuristic; the unfiltered sitewide feed remains available via sos-corporations.

items.title: Maine Secretary of State — Current Agency Rulemaking Notices
items._notes: Weekly omnibus rulemaking-notice list (links to .docx documents covering ALL Maine state agencies, not SOS-specific). Detects new/amended weekly postings; does not parse individual rule text.

items.title: Maine Notary / Apostille / Authentication Services
items.content_text: Maine Secretary of State / Notary / apostille / authentication
items._notes: Static services page with an occasional in-page notice banner; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Annual Report Filing Notices

items._notes: Static informational page describing the June 1 annual-report deadline and solicitation warnings; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Attorney General Opinions

items.title: Maine Attorney General Press Releases
items._notes: Verified working native RSS feed with current, matching items.

items.title: Maine AG Consumer Protection Scam Notices and Alerts

items._notes: Drupal Views date-list: each <li> has a <time datetime> and a linked title.

items.title: Governor of Maine — Official Documents (Executive Orders)
items._notes: Sitewide Governor's office feed, filtered to items whose links live under /official_documents/ (executive orders, proclamations, veto messages); press releases are excluded and carried by gov-press-releases instead.

items.title: Governor of Maine — Newsroom Press Releases
items._notes: Verified working native RSS feed; current items match the live newsroom page. Filtered to exclude /official_documents/ items (executive orders, proclamations, vetoes), which gov-executive-orders carries.

items._notes: Drupal Views list of nominee announcements linking directly to PDF/Word files; no per-item HTML detail page.

items._notes: Current-issue link plus year-range archive sub-pages of dated PDF alerts; monitored by full-page fingerprint of the index page. NOTE: maine.gov/revenue/rss.xml exists but is an empty/unused Drupal channel.

items.title: Maine Revenue Services Tax Return Forms
items._notes: Index links to per-tax-type/year subpages with per-form 'Revised <date>' text; monitored by full-page fingerprint of the index page. VERIFIED 2026-08: the index page itself is navigation-only (no repeating list), and per-tax-type subpages each have their own structure, so no stable selector exists; full-page fingerprinting remains the right tool here.

items.title: Maine Revenue Services Rules and Rulemaking
items._notes: Table of rules in effect plus a 'Current MRS Rulemaking Activity' table of proposed/pending changes.

items.title: Maine Department of Environmental Protection News & Media Releases
items._notes: Maine.gov publishes a 'What's New' RSS aggregator (tools/whatsnew/rss.php) that includes a working DEP feed, but maine.gov's own robots.txt disallows /tools/whatsnew/, so this source scrapes the DEP news page's GovDelivery-linked list directly instead.

items.title: Board of Environmental Protection — Meeting Materials (agendas & minutes)
items._notes: The BEP hears appeals of DEP decisions and major permit matters; its calendar table lists upcoming meetings plus linked agenda/minutes PDFs. VERIFIED 2026-08: rows have no stable per-row link structure (some carry agenda links via tools/whatsnew/attach.php, others none), so full-page fingerprint monitoring is the right tool — a new meeting posting or agenda surfaces as a change item with diff excerpt.

items.title: Maine Department of Health and Human Services News
items._notes: DHHS's advertised RSS feed (tid=32) is live but currently returns zero items; HTML page is the reliable source instead.

items.title: Maine Department of Labor News & Events
items._notes: Maine.gov publishes a 'What's New' RSS aggregator (tools/whatsnew/rss.php) that includes a working Labor feed, but maine.gov's own robots.txt disallows /tools/whatsnew/, so this source scrapes the Labor 'Latest News' list directly instead.

items.title: Maine Dept. of Professional and Financial Regulation Press Releases
items.content_text: Maine Agencies / Professional and Financial Regulation
items._notes: Page is sectioned by bureau, each its own table of Date / linked headline.

items.title: Maine Bureau of Insurance Bulletins
items._notes: Three-column table: Bulletin Number / Title (linked PDF) / Category. No per-row date column; items are timestamped when first observed.

items.title: Maine Bureau of Financial Institutions — News & Notices
items.content_text: Maine Agencies / Bureau of Financial Institutions
items._notes: Banking-regulator news list (branch closures, bylaw amendments, merger applications, consumer warnings) in the same Drupal Views shape as agency-dhhs-news. Relevant to banking/credit-union regulatory practice and to the securities-financial role.

items.title: Maine Real Estate Commission News & Publications
items._notes: Flat list of PDF links with no reliable per-item dates and infrequent updates; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: MaineCare Policy Bulletins
items._notes: Paginated, filterable table: Date / Title (linked) / Topic.

items.title: Maine Commission on Governmental Ethics and Election Practices — Notices
items._notes:
Homepage 'Notices' section is a flat sequence of

entries with no dates or list wrapper; monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: Maine Public Utilities Commission News & Press Releases
items._notes: List of headline links with an inline date span. The page's advertised RSS feeds (tid=802/211/227) return HTTP 500 and are not usable.

items.title: Maine Dept. of Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Newsroom
items._notes:
Repeating

headline

blocks, scoped to the main content region to exclude site nav/header headings, each followed by a sibling

whose leading text is the date. date_next_siblings walks that sibling text so items carry real publication dates instead of first-observed stamps.

items._notes: Drupal Views listing of news items.

The {scotus_ot_term} placeholder is resolved automatically at build time (scripts/common.py: scotus_ot_term()) using the rule that October Term N runs from the first Monday in October of year 2000+N through the following October — no manual update needed.

items.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — Opinions (govinfo)
items._notes: Official GPO govinfo USCOURTS feed of new/updated D. Maine opinions with authenticated GPO PDFs. Feed URL taken from GPO's own published feed directory (github.com/usgpo/rss). Complements fed-dme-opinions (CourtListener) with an official redundant path; some overlap between the two is expected. GPO notes feed notifications may pause during bulk reprocessing.

items.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — Opinions (govinfo)
items._notes: Official GPO govinfo USCOURTS feed of new/updated Bankr. D. Maine opinions with authenticated GPO PDFs. Feed URL taken from GPO's own published feed directory (github.com/usgpo/rss). Complements fed-meb-opinions (court's own PDF listing) and fed-meb-opinions-cl (CourtListener); overlap between the three is expected.

items.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — Opinions (CourtListener)
items._notes: Full-text Bankr. D. Maine opinions via CourtListener (Free Law Project), a free Atom feed with citation metadata. Complements fed-meb-opinions (which scrapes the court's own PDF listing grouped by judge) with a structured, full-text alternative; some overlap between the two feeds is expected.

items.title: U.S. Courts — Pending Rules and Forms Amendments
items._notes: Judiciary-wide status page for pending amendments to the Federal Rules of Civil, Criminal, Appellate, Bankruptcy, and Evidence procedure — the rules that govern every federal case in the District of Maine and the First Circuit. Prose/link page with no repeating dated list, monitored by full-page fingerprint so amendment postings surface as change items.

items.title: U.S. Supreme Court — Orders of the Court (current Term)

items._notes: Order List / miscellaneous-orders page for the current October Term (cert grants and denials, stays, and other orders), complementing fed-scotus-opinions' slip opinions. The two-digit {scotus_ot_term} placeholder is resolved automatically at build time (scripts/common.py: scotus_ot_term()), so no manual update is needed at the Term rollover. Client-updated table with no stable per-order list container, monitored by full-page fingerprint.

items.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — Local Rules
items._notes: The District of Maine's Local Rules and their amendment history — procedural rules governing every civil and criminal case filed in the district. items.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — Local Rules
items._notes: Local Rules of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Maine and their amendment history. Prose/link page with no repeating dated list, monitored by full-page fingerprint so rule amendments surface as change items.

items.title: U.S. Court of Appeals for the First Circuit — Local Rules
items._notes: First Circuit Local Rules and Internal Operating Procedures governing appeals from the District of Maine. Prose/link page with no repeating dated list, monitored by full-page fingerprint so rule amendments surface as change items.

items.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — CM/ECF Docket Entries (public RSS)
items.content_text: Federal Maine-Related / District Court docket activity
items._notes: The court's public CM/ECF RSS feed (verified live on the court's CourtInfo page): recent docket entries of type order/order-cr from the last 24 hours, free without a PACER login. Highest-frequency signal source for federal litigators. The upstream window is only 24 hours deep, so items rotate out quickly; the archive feed preserves them.

items.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — CM/ECF Docket Entries (public RSS)

items._notes: The bankruptcy court's public CM/ECF RSS feed (verified live on its CourtInfo page; configured for 'answer' entries from the last 24 hours, free without a PACER login). Often empty between filings — an empty item list here is normal, not a failure.

items.title: U.S. Court of Appeals for the First Circuit — Oral Arguments
items.content_text: Federal Maine-Related / First Circuit oral arguments
items._notes: Official oral-argument audio feed (recordings posted by the court on argument day), verified on the court's own subscribe page. Enclosure links carry MP3 recordings; useful for appellate practitioners tracking pending Maine appeals.

items.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Maine — Sitewide News Feed (official)
items._notes: The court publishes its own sitewide RSS covering News & Announcements, Opinions, and Local Rules (documented in the court's RSS User Guide). Structured redundancy for the scraped fed-meb-news / fed-meb-opinions / fed-meb-local-rules sources; overlap is expected and deduplicated in combined feeds.

items.title: Federal Register — Proposed Rules Matching 'Maine'

items.title: Curated — Real Estate & Title
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Real Estate & Title
items._notes: Relevant to real-estate, title, and conveyancing practice: registry of deeds recording fees and procedures, transfer-tax changes, property-fraud alerts, land-use and zoning, easements, foreclosure, and title standards.

items.title: Curated — Estate Planning & Probate
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Estate Planning & Probate
items._notes: Relevant to estate planning, probate, and fiduciary practice: probate court notices and forms, wills, trusts, estates, guardianship and conservatorship, notice to creditors, and elder law.

items.title: Curated — Bankruptcy & Creditor-Debtor
items._notes: Relevant to bankruptcy and creditor-debtor practice: U.S. Bankruptcy Court opinions, local bankruptcy rules, Chapter 7/11/13 matters, liens, UCC filings, collections, and debtor-creditor disputes.

items.title: Curated — Business & Corporate
items._notes: Relevant to business and corporate practice: corporate/LLC formation and annual-report filings, the Secretary of State corporations bureau, business court (BCD) decisions, commercial contracts, and mergers/acquisitions.

items.title: Curated — Employment & Labor
items._notes: Relevant to employment and labor practice: Department of Labor releases, wage-and-hour, workers' compensation, unemployment, workplace safety (OSHA), and labor-relations (NLRB) matters.

items.title: Curated — Civil Litigation & Appellate
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Civil Litigation & Appellate
items._notes: Relevant to civil litigators and appellate practitioners: Law Court and First Circuit opinions, U.S. Supreme Court opinions and orders, District Court opinions, rules of civil/appellate procedure, and standing/administrative court orders. Exclude purely criminal matters unless procedural.

items.title: Curated — Criminal Defense
items._notes: Relevant to criminal-defense and prosecution practice: criminal opinions, rules of criminal procedure, sentencing, indigent defense, and criminal-justice policy.

items.title: Curated — Family Law
items._notes: Relevant to family-law practice: divorce, custody, child support, parental rights, protection-from-abuse, adoption, and related family-court matters.

items.title: Curated — Consumer Protection
items._notes: Relevant to consumer-protection practice: Attorney General consumer alerts and scam notices, CFPB actions, unfair/deceptive practices, debt collection, and consumer-finance regulation.

items.title: Curated — Tax
items._notes: Relevant to tax practice: Maine Revenue Services tax alerts, rules, and forms; state and federal tax law changes; and tax-related rulemaking.

items.title: Curated — Securities & Financial Regulation
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Securities & Financial Regulation
items._notes: Relevant to securities and financial-regulation practice: SEC enforcement and rulemaking, banking and insurance regulation, the Bureau of Insurance, and professional/financial regulation.

items.title: Curated — Healthcare & Human Services
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Healthcare & Human Services
items._notes: Relevant to healthcare, public-benefits, and civil-rights practice: MaineCare policy bulletins, DHHS notices, Human Rights Commission decisions, licensing of health professionals, and disability/discrimination matters.

items.title: Curated — Environmental & Land Use
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Environmental & Land Use
items._notes: Relevant to environmental and land-use practice: Department of Environmental Protection actions, natural-resources and agriculture/forestry regulation, permitting, and environmental rulemaking.

items.title: Curated — Professional Responsibility & Ethics
items.content_text: Curated Practice-Area Feeds / Professional Responsibility & Ethics
items._notes: Relevant to all attorneys' professional obligations: Board of Overseers of the Bar discipline and ethics opinions, Maine Bar Rules and Rules of Professional Conduct amendments, bar admission announcements, and CLE.
